title: Paperless-AI
name: paperless-ai
description: AI sidekick for Paperless-ngx that reads each new document and fills in its title, tags, correspondent, type and date, plus a chat for asking questions across your whole archive. Works with OpenAI, Claude, Ollama and other compatible APIs. Source: https://github.com/clusterzx/paperless-ai
note: Open http://<your-host>:3900 straight away, since whoever gets to the setup wizard first makes the login. It asks for your Paperless-ngx address and an API token (in Paperless, your profile --> API Auth Token), then an AI provider. Use the host's IP rather than localhost for Paperless or a local Ollama, as localhost means the container itself. Out of the box it works through your WHOLE archive every 30 minutes, so with a paid API you'll want "Only process documents with specific tags" switched on first. Settings, history and the search index live in the /app/data volume, along with a 130 MB embedding model it downloads from Hugging Face the first time it indexes. Docs: github.com/clusterzx/paperless-ai
